backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual 10-K assets facts are known by SEC filed date (<= signal date) and compared against the prior comparable annual period. Same-sector peer ranks are computed at the signal date using only tickers whose current/prior assets were filed by that date. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

gate3.note: No new core filter or entry rule was added. The candidate source is additive default-off paper, so core signals generated/survived are unchanged from baseline.

hypothesis: PIT SEC Companyfacts annual asset growth that is low versus same-sector peers, paired with liquid SPY-relative confirmation, may identify capital-disciplined leaders better than absolute low-asset-growth thresholds.
interpretation: The industry-relative asset-growth source did not clear Gate 4 (failed: window_ev_regression, window_pnl_regression, drawdown_drift_too_high, target_concentration_failed, accepted_distribution_pnl_not_beaten). It is not retained or promoted.
next_evidence_needed: A retry needs materially different PIT investment-quality evidence, such as capex/free-cash-flow coverage, industry-relative capex/assets, manager-quality ownership context, or closed forward replacement rows. Do not sweep peer percentile, sector/industry grouping, asset-growth data-quality caps, fact age, RS/close/volume, top-N, hold, cooldown, or notional on these frozen windows.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT SEC Companyfacts annual asset growth that is low versus same-sector peers, paired with liquid SPY-relative confirmation, may separate disciplined capital allocators from stale low-growth balance sheets better than absolute low-asset-growth thresholds.

2_history_check.exp-20260613-031: Rejected operating-efficiency-assets support scaled earnings by assets; this run ranks asset growth cross-sectionally against sector peers using filed annual balance-sheet facts.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-020/024/025/027: Cash-conversion, quarterly cash conversion, TTM accruals, and TTM cash-flow acceleration were rejected or drawdown-failing. This run does not retune their ratios, fact age, stops, or thresholds.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-029: Diluted share contraction was rejected. Peer-relative asset growth is a distinct investment-discipline field.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-002: Standalone absolute low asset growth improved aggregate EV/PnL but regressed old_thin, worsened drawdown, and did not beat the distribution comparator on PnL.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-003: Cash-backed low asset growth also improved aggregate EV/PnL but failed old_thin, drawdown, and distribution-PnL comparators. Its recorded next evidence asked for industry-relative asset-growth surprise rather than another threshold sweep.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and the accepted compression and distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Absolute low asset growth and cash-backed low asset growth were positive but failed old_thin/drawdown. Industry-relative asset growth is a distinct PIT cross-sectional investment-discipline field, but nearby Companyfacts quality lanes are crowded and distribution/compression comparators are binding.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing annual 10-K current/prior assets, missing same-sector peer group, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT annual 10-K asset-growth peer rank, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
